# Justine Seguido, GoHighLevel Developer

> HighLevel Certified Admin based in San Miguel, Leyte, Philippines (GMT+8). Builds GoHighLevel (GHL) systems that turn enquiries into booked appointments for dental practices, med spas and aesthetics clinics, and garages and MOT centres, plus white label GoHighLevel builds for marketing agencies. Clients are mainly in the UK, the US and New Zealand.

## Services

- Speed to lead: instant text replies to new enquiries, and missed call text back
- Appointment booking, reminders, confirmations and no-show follow-up
- Voice AI receptionists that answer calls and book into the calendar, with SMS fallback
- MOT and service reminders for garages
- Review requests and customer reactivation
- WhatsApp automation with Meta approved templates
- Integrations through Make.com, Zapier and APIs (Dentally, Shopify, Klaviyo, Xero, Ascora, OwnerRez)
- CRM migrations to GoHighLevel, and snapshots
- White label builds delivered under the agency's own brand

## Pricing (one-time, no retainer required)

- Landing Page: $497, 3 to 5 days
- Website + Automations: $1,497, 7 to 10 days
- Full GHL System: $2,997, 10 to 14 days, includes 30 days of support
- Custom builds (migrations, API integrations, WhatsApp, IVR call routing): quoted after a discovery call
- Monthly retainers are available after launch
